roleContext.jobDescription: The credit workflow system at a commercial bank runs on an internal Kubernetes platform. The Platform Engineer owns the workflow system's runtime platform end-to-end, decides and executes production changes to the cluster configuration, leads the platform change review, and is accountable to the head of platform engineering for the platform's availability. The platform runs the workflow system for the bank's commercial lending business, and the role works with the application team, the security function and the bank's change management process.

requirements.text: Owns the workflow system's runtime platform end-to-end and decides and executes production configuration changes.
Builds and maintains the platform's infrastructure code and deployment pipelines.
Leads the weekly platform change review and records decisions.
Coordinates changes with the application team and security and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents runbooks, known limitations and hand-over conditions for each platform change.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Platform Engineer, Credit Workflow System

## Experience

- Owned the runtime platform for the credit workflow system for three years, deciding and executing production configuration changes to the Kubernetes clusters myself as the platform's named owner, with the change record carrying my approval and my execution.
- Built and maintained the platform's infrastructure code (Terraform, Helm charts) and the deployment pipelines that promote the workflow application through test, staging and production.
- Led the weekly platform change review, deciding which application and platform changes were scheduled into the production window and recording the decisions in the change-review log.
- Coordinated changes with the application team and security, recording that the application team owned application configuration and security owned the policy baseline while I owned the cluster configuration and the production window.
- Responsibilities included platform ownership, production change decisions and execution, infrastructure code, pipelines and the weekly change review over about three years.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the platform ownership entry in the engineering service catalogue and the change records for one month showing approval and execution under the candidate's user id, with the change tool's identifiers as a verification trail.
